feedback:
Written before this candidate races. The candidate is the iteration 9 design (best raced at 432.15: kp 1.8, kd 0.4, ki 0.5, base_speed 1.2, y 0.07, sensor_size 0.012, last_direction) with one geometry change: the sensor x spread narrows from +/-0.05 to +/-0.04. I checked the controller fields against iteration 9 and they match.

Why it is a reasonable test: iteration 4 (x spread +/-0.07) cut oval finish to 0.6 and lowered slalom progress to 0.11, so widening clearly hurt. The opposite direction has not been tried at this geometry. Iteration 9 shows that kp 1.8 lifted s-bend progress to 0.68 and left the oval at 20 of 20, so the controller is in a good state, and a single-variable geometry change is the right next step. Slalom progress has held at about 0.186 across iterations 3, 5, 7, 8 and 9, which suggests the slalom loss is set by sensor geometry at the sharpest entry. Iteration 8 (base_speed 1.0) cut s-bend progress to 0.35, so do not lower speed.

Risk: the narrower array sees less tape on the sharpest bends, so line loss could rise and s-bend progress could fall with it, as well as slalom. The oval may be steadier on straights.

Read the race in this order. (1) If slalom progress rises above 0.19 and s-bend progress stays at or above about 0.6, keep the narrower spread and consider a further step to +/-0.03. (2) If slalom and s-bend both fall, the spread at +/-0.05 is the best trade-off, so return to it and treat the slalom as a limit of the current sensor layout. (3) If the oval finish drops below 1.0 or oval steering_oscillation rises well above 0.25, check the narrower spread on straights before taking any further step.
requested_changes: If slalom progress rises above 0.19 with the narrower spread and s-bend progress stays at or above about 0.6, keep geometry.sensor_positions x at -0.04, -0.02, 0, 0.02, 0.04 and try a further step to +/-0.03, since iteration 4 showed wider spread hurt and this is the opposite direction.

If slalom and s-bend progress both fall below iteration 9 values (0.186 and 0.68) with the narrower spread, return geometry.sensor_positions x to +/-0.05 (iteration 9 baseline) and keep kp 1.8, since narrowing removes tape coverage on the sharpest bends.
Do not lower controller.base_speed. Iteration 8 showed base_speed 1.0 cut s-bend progress from 0.68 to 0.35 without moving slalom progress (0.187), so keep base_speed 1.2.
